declarations.name: AuiMenuBar

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the menubar (aria-label). Must be a non-empty string.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Non-empty list of menubar items { id, label, icon?, disabled?, items? }. Items with items open a Menu; items without are commands. Ids are unique across the bar and all of its menus.

inputs.name: renderItem
inputs.description: Custom item content (since 0.9.0); the label stays the accessible name and typeahead text. Nodes are reused per item and released with releaseNode when dropped.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides passed to every menu.

inputs.name: closeOnSelect
inputs.description: Menus close after activating a checkbox or radio item. Action items always close the menu.

inputs.name: typeahead
inputs.description: Printable characters move focus to the next bar item (skipping disabled items) or menu item whose label starts with them.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Arrow-key mirroring and menu/submenu sides. An inherited dir=rtl on the host also makes the bar RTL.

outputs.name: selected
outputs.description: A command bar item or an enabled menu item was activated. Always dispatched on the host (menu selections are re-dispatched there). checked is the new state for checkbox and radio items.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close any open menu; focus returns to its menubar item when it was inside the menu.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Menubar with Menu popups (the Menu component and engine); roving tabindex on the bar, real DOM focus on menu items.

limitations: Horizontal only; there is no vertical menubar and no overflow collapse (items wrap instead).
update() and any global menuBar configuration change re-render the bar and rebuild every menu: an open menu closes, focus inside it is not restored, and checkbox/radio state resets to the item data.
An explicit direction 'ltr' does not override an inherited dir=rtl on the host; menus read the direction when the bar renders, so a later dir change reaches the menus only on the next render.
Menu placement is fixed at bottom-start; the global menu configuration does not apply to menubar menus.
Disabled items with items render aria-haspopup=menu but no menu, so they cannot be opened or inspected.
